title: Two Instances of Chaos in Deterministic and Quantum Dynamical Systems
summary: This thesis consists of two distinct projects situated in the areas of smooth dynamics and spectral theory, respectively. They are united by a common interest in mechanisms of chaos and statistical behavior in classical and quantum dynamical systems. The first concerns smooth dynamics. We prove that all ergodic linear automorphisms of the N-dimensional torus with two-dimensional center are stably ergodic, including all ergodic automorphisms in dimensions $N \leq 5$ and $N = 7$ .
